description: Val Hoyle announced the endorsement of Oregon’s Governor, Tina Kotek - who has one of the highest disapproval ratings of any Governor in the country. Under Kotek and Hoyle’s reign, Oregonians have seen homelessness skyrocket, safely decline, and Oregon go backward in every meaningful economic metric. Tina Kotek and Val Hoyle do not reflect the values of Oregon's 4th District- this endorsement further underscores the need for new leadership in Oregon.
